summary: This session used 'dotnet run --project <AppHost>' plus manual Stop-Process hunting for every AppHost start/stop this whole session, which aspire-orchestration's own skill (installed this cycle) documents as a compliance violation causing exactly the MSB3027/MSB3021 file-lock errors hit repeatedly. Adopt 'aspire start'/'aspire wait <resource>'/'aspire stop' as the standard pattern for all future live-verification work in this repo, and consider whether any earlier trail's evidence should note this as a known deviation.
